body:
Two real follow-ups to the Four Kings fix (S188-01), both from live playtesting: (1) 'i killed the purple king and couldnt even tell if i got a buff' -- same class of bug as the Kings-invisibility fix, buff state (king_music_carrier/king_growth_ms/king_wealth_ms/king_allseeing_team_ms) fully real server-side but zero wire representation. Added king_buff_flags to ArenaHeroSnapshot, populated server-side, rendered as a bottom-right buff-icon HUD client-side (per-King thematic colors, Bloodroar's real stack count shown). (2) 'the 4 kings need health bars and name tags' -- added, reusing heroes' own HP-bar idiom scaled up for boss-tier read. Both ported to GFD's battlegrounds_gui fork (commits 72b6615, 2a1ccfb) and deployed live to redgarden-stable (the actual GFD Battlegrounds backend) via the documented promotion procedure, both services confirmed active/stable post-restart. go test/build clean throughout. REDGARDEN commits 3c2f131, 546a4ca.

⚓ ☃
title: King buff HUD + King health bars/name tags -- deployed live
